What the registers say

Tours

Weight matrices

Legend

node / tile:
 brightness = |value| / max of its group (shown in the group label); blue = negative; non-zero ≥ 12%
weight > 0  weight < 0
 width / opacity by |w| tier (log scale, per layer); every non-zero weight is drawn individually, nothing else
3×3 squares beside a layer-1 unit: its kernel slice per channel read, coloured by sign and |w| / unit max; empty outlines = taps whose weight is exactly 0 (the input lines land on the tap that weights them)
particles: size and brightness ∝ |input × w| for the focused cell, normalised per layer and target group
tap outside the grid (zero pad)
patch tap no weight reads (all diagonals; img away from the centre)
source: the focused cell / its 3×3 neighbourhood gathered into the perception patch
write-back: the new state written into the grid cell, and the 4 neighbours that read it next step
faint small dots = unused units (all-zero weights)
